scope: Cape Verde medical discovery — Universidade de Cabo Verde Integrated Master's in Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Uni-CV's current 2026/27 admissions FAQ identifies a specific Integrated Master's in Medicine admissions and entrance-examination regulation.
Uni-CV states that Medicine selection combines the third-cycle average (35%), a core-subject mark (15%) and the entrance-exam result (50%).

The official admissions FAQ requires Medicine applicants to use the university's online application platform, submit the documents required by the general and Medicine-specific rules, and pay the generated DUC; it lists a CVE 3,000 registration-fee receipt among the admissions documents.
Cape Verde's official 2025 medical-career decree requires a medicine degree and registration with the Ordem dos Médicos de Cabo Verde for medical employment pathways it governs.

holdReasons: No current Medicine tuition or mandatory-fee schedule was located. The CVE 3,000 item is an application/registration document fee, not tuition.

The current admissions FAQ confirms that a 2026/27 Medicine regulation exists but the reviewed public material does not expose a complete current deadline, vacancy count, academic eligibility detail or an international-applicant route.
Programme duration, teaching language, named clinical partners, recognition/accreditation, accommodation, scholarship/loan support and full graduate-registration implications remain unverified.
nextAction: Obtain Uni-CV's active Medicine regulation and fee decision, then verify programme structure, language, clinical training and student-support evidence before preparing a payload.
